question: Who among the following has launched the US Startup SETU programme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Piyush Goyal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​SETU, or Supporting Entrepreneurs in Transformation and Upskilling,** is a **Ministry of Commerce & Industry** project in India.
 
• The program will provide** mentorship and support **in a variety of areas, including** fundraising, market access, and commercialization, for start-ups in India **by connecting them to** investors and start-up ecosystem **experts in the US.
 
• The interaction will be supported by the mentorship site offered by **Startup India's MAARG program, **which is a one-stop shop for finding solutions for businesses in India.
 
• Its full form is** Mentorship, Advice, Assistance, Resilience, and Growth.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Amit Shah :**

 
 
• **Indian politician** Amit Anil Chandra Shah has been the **home affairs minister since 2019.**
 
 
 
• **Yogi Adityanath:**
 
 
• Yogi Adityanath, a politician and Hindu monk from India, is currently** Uttar Pradesh's 21st chief minister.**
 
 
 
• **Nitin Gadkari:**
 
 
• The **Minister for Road Transport & Highways** in the Indian Government is Nitin Jairam Gadkari, a Maharashtrian politician.
 
 
 
• **Piyush Goyal:**
 
 
• Piyush Goyal is the **Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution**
